title: GN-003 GUNDAM KYRIOS
summary: Aside from poor MG Exia and its variants, all the 00 gundams are absolute beasts in the form of MG with highly details and top notch quality. Dynames, Virtue, and Kyrios are carefully crafted to capture their anime counterpart with precision. Knowing that I'm too late into building them, especially since everyone have seen it already themselves, I can't resist making a video for it.
body: There is nothing special to say about this kit.

Aside from poor MG Exia and its variants, all the 00 gundams are absolute beasts in the form of MG with highly details and top notch quality. Dynames, Virtue, and Kyrios are carefully crafted to capture their anime counterpart with precision. Knowing that I'm too late into building them, especially since everyone have seen it already themselves, I can't resist making a video for it.
